text_to_speech: "Open wide!" Most nights, you see something like this... and walk right on by. A Ridden-infested tunnel, slithering through the Earth's bowels? Thanks but no thanks, right? Trust me when you need to dig up a little extra equipment... you start to think: ... damn, there's gotta be some good shit down there! We never know where or when we'll discover these Ridden Hives… Fighting your way out of these twisted, underground mazes… it's a whole new can of worms. Name's Sharice. Used to pull people out of burning buildings... now I say burn it all to the ground! That's Heng. Pretty deadly for an old guy. "I'm not getting any younger so let's do this." Used to have his own restaurant and you know what they say: a chef's best friend is a sharp knife. "How's this for your last meal?" I guess you can't poke the hornet's nest without stirring up a few new surprises. Urchin. Shredder. And the Ripper. Looks like a bug fucked a porcupine. No amount of training gets you ready for this shit! But we've got a few new tricks up our sleeves. "Service with a smile." When you're up against a whole hive, you've got to be prepared. And you can never have too many toys. Hope you're not claustrophobic. "Oh, this should be fun."

youtube_description:
They call it the Tunnels of Terror… you’re not afraid are you?

On April 12, 2022, Back 4 Blood brings you Tunnels of Terror. Tunnels of Terror features the all-new PvE areas “Ridden Hives”, along with 2 new playable Cleaners, 7 new Legendary Weapons, 12 weapon skins, new cards, 8 premium skins, and the fearsome Warped Ridden to discover below the depths of Evansburgh. The expansion will coincide with the release of the No Hope difficulty, a free update adding an extra level of challenge for elite players.

Please note, all playable content included in the Tunnels of Terror expansion will be accessible by all players in a party as long as one player in that party has purchased the expansion.

Available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One consoles, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4 and PC.

Join the fight against the Ridden!
